archetypes.name: dyn-reviewer-prompt-contract
archetypes.rationale: Reviewer prompt grammar and generated artifacts can drift while adding the style directive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan preserves reviewer output wire formats while adding the readability directive to generated and hand-maintained prompts. Focus on token-substitution boundaries, pre-rendered drift, manifest coverage, and the panel-tier closure baseline. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
